[quote=gendarme;58339141][b]Juane Island, Capricorn[/b]
[b][Jan.31.25][/b]

[i]The ringing of sirens flooded the island, military officials scattered to organize their forces and divisions. Amiral Étienne Leclerc rushed to central command to get a grasp of the current situation. "[b]We've received over 65 unidentified signatures within a 200KM radius of Juane.[/b]" reported one of the data analysts. Admiral Étienne looked closer at the screen, "[b]Go into Satelite view, something's not right..[/b]." the analyst complied and entered 3D satelite view. He zoomed into the Naval vessels before pausing. "[b]These are no commercial vessels..., THEY'RE BRAVANORIAN COMBAT VESSELS![/b]" the atmosphere soon devolved into panic, a combat force of such size would be a tedious task to expel. "[b]READY THE COASTAL DEFENSE BATTERIES![/b]" Étienne ordered, he quickly ran out the Command Center towards the living quarters of the military base. Dashing through halls and corners before reaching the Maharaja Family's living quarters. He soon barged in, "[b]Pack your clothes, your food, everything! You will be relocated to mainland Gendarme where it's safe, we seem to have an unexpected guest.[/b]" the Maharaja's family was large, the fact they have to flee from the Raj to Capricorn, then to flee again to Gendarme was not the best news they could receive. But it had to be done, or else they could risk capture. The family quickly followed the Admiral as he led them through multiple halls until they reached an underground hidden tunnel system, these tunnels would lead them straight towards Base aérienne de Juane, an aerial quarters that would allow them to escape the islands that will soon become a warzone.[/i]

[b]Chantier naval de La Forge de Juane[/b]
[pre]The Gendarmite Capricornian fleet was able to organize itself quickly, an interception force of 4 Destroyers, 6 Corvettes, 2 Amphibious Assualt ships, 3 Submarines, and 2 Support ships would be called upon in this time of Emergency. Capricorn would be declared under martial law while Alicia would begin to mobilize its standing army. The Gendarmite 4th and 12 Colonial garrisons would be activated and reservist forces are to be mobilized. These actions would bring the garrisons within Capricorn to a standing of 10.000, while Coastal Defenses and SAM launchers would take positions all over the islands to ensure the hostile enemy didn't have the potential to salvo the islands.[/pre][/quote]
[i]"SIR ADMIRAL SIR"
The marine once again came to Admiral Soares.
"Yes I know, our land troops already confirmed(that small piece of land I own in one of your islands have a small garrison)
They detected our movements, and are certainly moving their fleets already, prepare to reinforce our logistical and land on Damião de Souto ASAP.
"All the ships prepare to move to Damião de Souto, we are detected,  and vulnerable, I repeat, put your engines to move to Damião de Souto Immediately, the Second group must circle the area to make  sure no submarine reach the logistics nor the main ships"
And the next movements of the navy was decided, protect the transporters and logistic ships at all costs while being wary of any submarine or ship that could possess any threat.
-------------------------------------------------

The garrison defending the island was limited to a total of 10000 soldiers(10k), under the command of the Colonel Lucas Pereira Marques, the port of the city soon were preparing for the disembark of the Imperial ships.
The garrison was not yet ready to attack, and would defend against any possible attack until the navy arrives, the AA defences were prepared and the Coastal defence batteries were ready, the armies were not yet wary of the defenses of the island at the Gendarmenite side, and a mission of drones were sent to spy and detect the defenses of the rest of the "Damião de Souto" island.
soldiers were just to prepare for the war, trainings were more intense, and the local populace would also be trained in case of the Gendermane invade the Bravanorian piece of land.

"[i]I have heard. Come, sit. Have a nice seat in this beautifully crafted [b]red[/b] 'throne.' " As they look at the sunset, and the beautiful colors of orange, yellow, red, and purple, "[i]Not much places have this beautiful sky to look at every single night. Something to look forward to at the end of the day. Especially in the raj; they are too busy working to provide basic resources for their family. Every day, they can barely afford basic food and water. For this, they must slave away every day. But, obviously, I won't let them do this suffering for long. When I visited the island a long time ago, the inhabitants wanted nothing to do with society. They only wanted to be left alone but would accept only a small portion of visitors every once 'n a while. They happened to have been forgotten about long ago. I wonder what happened to them. I wonder if they are working as slaves, serving the same fates as all of the lower class people.[/i]" The man had to excuse himself because he needed to use the bathroom. He glanced over at the dying day and continued his business. The

As the Circle was being filled by the government leaders and the Heads of War from the [b]ASSR[/b] and its allies; tensions only rose. "We are here to discuss matters concerning gendarme's overseas territory." Introduced Karcson, Leader of the [b]ASSR[/b]. "Yes, we are aware of the tension between you two. First, we need to know what we're dealing with." Says the president of Goleornacha. "Don't worry, I've got that covered. The [b]GCPR[/b] has been gathering Intel. Well, at a rather slow pace, but still efficiently enough. We do know that they are waiting for us in the front, and the back.- "What the f'ck is a [b]GCPR[/b]?" Interrupts the leader of Epikanus, "Sorry," "The [b]GCPR[/b] stands for 'Gendarmite Communist Party of the Raj' It's a realitively small party, but has done some interesting things. Anyway, as I said, they are waiting for us in the front, and the back of the Raj, they've blocked it pretty damn good, so it's not going to be easy to break it. Luckily, we are not dumb, so we will [b][REDACTED][/b]" "Now hold on just a minute, hold on. You're telling me they will have a strong line on both sides, as well as a line around me and Goleornacha? How much navy does he have?" Says the Leader of Demste "You can't underestimate anyone. Especially a colonial empire. He has a navy. Though, the navy will be split in 3, and stretched over a large space. We can use this to our advantage." 

[b]The Circle, New Texas[/b] [i]17 hours before the 'Liberation of Raj'[/i]

[u]_               _ _ _              _[/u]

Multiple hours of talking with the war generals, and a back and fourth later, the Circle had finally finished the war plan, and was almost ready. [b]"KARLUMOV![/b] How many military factories have you opened? And how many new recruits do we have trained?" Karcson asked. [b]"[Redacted] SIR! WE HAVE ALSO RECRUITED APPROXIMATELY [Redacted] SIR! ALL WITHIN A WEEK, WITH MINIMUM DELAY.[/b] "Do you also have the [i]planes[/i] ready?" [b]" YES SIR, THEY WILL NOT BE EXPECTING THEM, SIR. FULLY MODERNIZED AND TRAINED DIVISIONS. READY FOR DEPLOYMENT![/b] "Good, send out the recons over the entire region. Do not engage. I will attack tomorrow.

The Arenetts were ready, along with aid for and from their allies. 

[b][Radio Static] "This just in, the Arenett Socialist States have declared an act of war upon the Empire of Gendarme to 'reclaim' the once peacefully lands of Gendarme's colony in the southeast region. His allies will join. They all have the same goal in a common: to gain land from the empire, and to dissolve its colonies in an attempt to push foreign power out of the region. Run. Hide. Escape. This war will not end well for the both of us![/b]

[b]Juane Island Central Military Command, Capricorn[/b]

[i]"[b]CAPRICRON TO GENDARMITE CENTRAL COMMAND, THIS IS ADMIRAL ÉTIENNE LECLERC! WE HAVE DETECTED A HOSTILE FIGHTING FORCE ENCLOSING IN ON THE CAPRICORN TERRITORY, AND WE IMMEDIATELY REQUEST ECONOMIC AND MILITARY SUPPORT T ENSURE THE AGGRESSORS ARE EXPELLED.[/b]" 

Leclerc smashed the phone down before levelling the whole desk in a fit of rage. This was his fourth distress call to the Gendarmite Central command and they are yet to answer, can't they see the existence of Capricorn is in threat? Suddenly, a loud ring would be heard, the source of it the smashed phone Leclerc threw. Leclerc would let out a loud sigh before picking up the phone and greeting. "[b]Admiral Leclerc, your cries have fallen to deaf ears. We have received your distress call and we're actively working toward finding a safe way to transport an aid package to Capricorn. Please, do not fret. We are with you, and we promise to not leave you and your men astray to the invaders. From now on, you are officially dispatched to command the Gendarmite Argos Fleet, Capricornian Army, Alician Marines, and the Argosian Air force. Make use of these assets wisely, we cannot afford a single loss on our hand.[/b]" Leclerc ended the call before packing his stuff and leaving, now he needed to move to an area far away from the potential war zone to properly operate his new found forces. Over 80.000 potential soldiers were at his hand, 30 ships, and 90 aircraft. All of these he had to make good use of. 
[b]__________________[/b][/i]

[b]Juane-Sebastião Border, Capricorn/Bravanor
[/b]

The Gendarmite Colonial Army(GCA) initiated its first stage of defenses against the impending Bravanorian invasion, Engineer battalions began forming a 10KM long, 15KM wide "Super-Trench", that would ensure the defense of the Gendarmites from the impending invasion. Satellite systems set up around Juane Island started detecting foreign drones that would quickly spike activity within the Gendarmite trenches, missile systems would be tasked with shooting down and ridding any potential spy drone that would be able to capture important reconnaissance info across the border. By morning, GCA forces would operate a strategic battery assault on Bravanorian operatives all across the border, these attacks would be led by the Gendarmite Strategic Armory(GSA) who would pinpoint these locations using satellites.

Official Statement from the Great Kingdom of Ekpatanus

To: The Global Community
Date: January 31, 2025
Subject: Announcement of Membership in the ETO Pact 

In the Name of the Almighty,

The Great Kingdom of Ekpatanus proudly announces that, following numerous diplomatic meetings between Ekpatanus and the Gendarme, we have officially joined the ETO Pact. This membership, effective from 8:00 AM on January 31, 2025, marks a significant step in our commitment to regional and global stability.

In accordance with Article 1 of the ETO Pact, we are committed to providing full military and intelligence support to our allies, the Gendarme and Bantarus. To this end, our Air Force, known as Εσκί Γκοστ, and our Naval Forces, Ναυτική Στόλος, have been placed on full alert to respond to any emerging threats.

However, it is essential to clarify our strategic stance in the ongoing conflicts. In this particular war, we intend to avoid direct military engagement with the Stated Socialist Republics of North Arenenge to the extent necessary and possible, focusing instead on safeguarding our primary borders and protecting our allies in the continent of Elseyr. Accordingly, one-third of the Ekpatanus Navy will be deployed to contested regions, while two-thirds will remain dedicated to defending our territorial waters and vital trade passages.

Our esteemed King, Kaesarus III Sam Michaelidis, emphasizes that this measured approach aims to uphold peace while reinforcing our defensive capabilities and promoting unity among our allies. We believe it is crucial to maintain stability in the region, fostering an environment where cooperation prevails over conflict.

With respect,

Jürgen Andropoulos
Minister of Foreign Affairs  
The Great Kingdom of Ekpatanus
